# incident.io synthetic saved responses

Fields are written from the official tagged OpenAPI specifications at https://docs.incident.io/openapi/tags/status-pages-v2.json, status-page-structures-v2.json, status-page-components-v2.json, status-page-incidents-v2.json and status-page-maintenances-v2.json, read 23 October 2026. Identifiers and cursor values are synthetic-lamp values. The short first incident page still carries a next cursor: the empty second page is required to establish completion.

The maintenance fixture deliberately contains only the documented actual component periods. These cannot establish its original planned schedule and the dry run refuses it with a reason. No component creation/current-state field, public permalink, subscriber export, customer-published postmortem or customer template response is invented. Response postmortems/templates are internal resources and are not fetched. No provider account was used.
